<h2>Calibrate Cross-Validation Grid Size</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Compares candidate spatial-grid sizes using occupied-cell density and fold
balance, then marks the finest eligible candidate.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>compute_cross_validation_grid_calibration(
  data_locations = NULL,
  candidate_grid_cell_sizes_km = NULL,
  n_folds = 5L,
  n_repeats = 1L,
  occupancy_criterion = "median",
  target_locations_per_cell = NULL,
  lower_quantile_probability = 0.25,
  max_fold_location_difference = 1L,
  max_fold_sample_difference = Inf,
  seed = 900723L
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_locations">data_locations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Location table returned by [build_cross_validation_location_table()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="candidate_grid_cell_sizes_km">candidate_grid_cell_sizes_km</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric vector of unique positive candidate grid-cell widths in kilometres.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="n_folds">n_folds</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single integer greater than one and no greater than the location count.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="n_repeats">n_repeats</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single positive integer used to evaluate deterministic origin shifts.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="occupancy_criterion">occupancy_criterion</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar: '&quot;minimum&quot;', '&quot;lower_quantile&quot;', or '&quot;median&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_locations_per_cell">target_locations_per_cell</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive numeric occupancy target. Defaults to 'n_folds' when 'NULL'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="lower_quantile_probability">lower_quantile_probability</code></td>
<td>
<p>Probability used by '&quot;lower_quantile&quot;', between zero and '0.5'. Defaults
to '0.25'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="max_fold_location_difference">max_fold_location_difference</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum allowed difference between the largest and smallest fold location
counts within any repeat. Defaults to '1L'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="max_fold_sample_difference">max_fold_sample_difference</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum allowed difference between fold sample counts within any repeat.
Defaults to 'Inf' so it is diagnostic until calibrated explicitly.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="seed">seed</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single non-negative integer assignment seed. Defaults to '900723L'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Candidate assignments use [build_spatial_cross_validation_assignments()].
Eligibility requires the configured occupancy statistic and both balance
thresholds. Among eligible candidates, the smallest cell size is selected.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Tibble with one row per candidate grid size, occupancy and balance
diagnostics, eligibility, selection status, and a single 'selected' flag
when at least one candidate is eligible.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_locations &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    location_id = letters[1:6],
    coord_x_km = c(0, 1, 2, 10, 11, 12),
    coord_y_km = rep(0, 6),
    n_samples = rep(1L, 6),
    row_indices = as.list(seq_len(6L))
  )
compute_cross_validation_grid_calibration(
  data_locations = data_locations,
  candidate_grid_cell_sizes_km = c(1, 10),
  n_folds = 3L
)
</code></pre>

</main>
